notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[p]Hello everybody! I hope you are all enjoying Fish n' Ships![/p][p]This patch is mainly to fix several bugs that have been pointed out to me since launch, I appreciate everyone's patience and assistance with these![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where players would earn the "Finder o' Fish" Achievement Prematurely[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing ship cosmetic graphics to tear and freak out[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug involved in fish spawning ranges in the later areas[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the hook grease causing issues upon using too close to another fish[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I also did a tiny bit of balancing to some of the shop items, added some enhanced visuals to make some aspects of the game easier to understand, and fixed a few typos.

That's all for now! Now get back out there and get fishing![/p]
